SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Map Reading and Interpretation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Map Reading and Interpretation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Map Reading and Interpretation never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Map Reading and Interpretation.
   D. Treat Map Reading and Interpretation as rumours only.

2. Which statement about Self- Esteem Assessment is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Esteem Assessment.
   B. Say Self- Esteem Assessment never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Self- Esteem Assessment as rumours only.
   D. Explain Self- Esteem Assessment with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. Which statement about Diversity and interpersonal skills is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Diversity and interpersonal skills never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Diversity and interpersonal skills as rumours only.
   C. Explain Diversity and interpersonal skills with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Diversity and interpersonal skills.

4. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Destroying road signs

5. Which statement about Scientific Theory about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Scientific Theory about Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Scientific Theory about Human Origin.
   C. Treat Scientific Theory about Human Origin as rumours only.
   D. Say Scientific Theory about Human Origin never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Population Growth in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Population Growth in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Population Growth in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Population Growth in Africa.
   D. Treat Population Growth in Africa as rumours only.

7. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Plan income and spending wisely
   B. Ignore prices in shops
   C. Hide all money underground
   D. Avoid saving forever

8. Which statement about Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration.
   D. Explain Peaceful Conflict Resolution ● Negotiation ● Mediation ● Arbitration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

9. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

10. Which statement about Vegetation in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Vegetation in Africa.
   B. Treat Vegetation in Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Vegetation in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Vegetation in Africa never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Self- Improvement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Self- Improvement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Improvement.
   C. Treat Self- Improvement as rumours only.
   D. Say Self- Improvement never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Trans Saharan Slave Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Trans Saharan Slave Trade as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Trans Saharan Slave Trade.
   C. Explain Trans Saharan Slave Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Trans Saharan Slave Trade never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Map Reading and Interpretation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Weather and Climate ● Desert ● Semi-desert ● Tropical ● Mediterranean ● Mountain and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Vegetation in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Historical Sites and Monuments in Africa ● Fort Jesus ● Kilwa ● Great Zimbabwe ● and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
